lockedDecisions.decision: Portrait-mobile idle and incremental RPG led by four named cats or cat-people, auto battle, unbounded tower and combat-supporting shops and delivery.
Four permanent battle slots: Mugi, Luna, Toto and Kohaku. Temporary support is a separate layer.
Direct tap damage is zero. Auto battle and offline progress are foundational.
movement then engagement or range, anticipation, release or contact, impact, damage and HP change, hit reaction, defeat, reward and progression.
The player sees no final floor. 10F and 100F are milestones, not endings; 101F and beyond continue.
Commerce supports DPS, survival, coin flow and reclear speed and never replaces battle as the protagonist or requires routine collection chores.
One reset system, reset.tower_return, returns to Floor 1 with defined retained acceleration and idempotent reward handling.
Unbounded permanent values use canonical decimal strings or a versioned arbitrary-precision type, never unsafe JavaScript Number semantics.
Permanent economy, purchases, gacha results, acquisition, pity, reset rewards and highest floor are server authoritative. localStorage is not authority.
Character and weapon gacha are separate; first copy is functional; compound gacha is prohibited; N and R deterministic roles remain viable.
React owns HUD and controls, Phaser owns battle rendering, packages/domain owns deterministic state and events, and build output is dist/v2.
Work only on task/v2-bootstrap, integrate by PR to kimi, leave main frozen, do not create another branch or merge PR 9 without authority.
Warm wood, brass, stone and burgundy tower workshop with premium pixel-art chibi cats, role-readable silhouettes, cold enemy separation and battle-first hierarchy.
Existing S02 Golden Masters and assets are reference-only, are not user-visually-approved and are not authorized as production runtime assets or a complete-screen raster.
Prove representative four-cat, enemy, background, component and causal animation quality in a browser before mass-producing final assets.
Vercel READY, browser emulation and physical iPhone verification are separate claims. Unknown evidence remains NOT_VERIFIED.
